mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals weakening labor market strength, prompting investors to anticipate slower growth and sell equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE >4.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both total demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signals robust economic momentum, attracting capital to equities and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite both GDPC1 and HOUST rising above their 5-day moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: An expansion in supply-side indicators, such as the INDPRO index exceeding 105, reflects increased production capacity, reducing upward pressure on prices and encouraging equity purchases, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below 105 in >60% of triggered instances or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in jobless claims (PAYEMS) indicates tightening monetary policy coupled with improving labor market conditions, creating a contractionary yet stabilizing environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative when FEDFUNDS rises >0.5% and PAYEMS falls below 10k.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in total demand (GDPC1) over six months reflects growing economic activity, which lowers risk premiums and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 declines over the 6-month horizon or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate below 2% and a corresponding drop in the federal funds rate below 3.5% signals a strong labor market coupled with accommodative monetary policy, fostering investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative when both UNRATE <2.0% and FEDFUNDS <3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both total demand (GDPC1) and supply-side production (INDPRO) reflects balanced economic growth, reducing uncertainty and attracting capital to equities, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO rising above their 5-day moving averages.
